grade.message: My Delta flight to Atlanta (DLR10A) was cancelled for weather so I cancelled the trip. The hotel (Hilton, conf 30188410, 2 nights) marked me a no-show and refunded one night. I called Hilton's helpline and they told me both nights would be refunded because it was a weather cancellation. I sent the hotel the proof and they still say one night. Can you get me the second night back? And the flight refund please, to my card. priya.raman@example.com, card 5010.
